newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: C&P says 9-mth net seen close to 2 bln peso.
newsitem.headline: C&P says 9-mth net seen close to 2 bln peso.

text.p: Mass housing developer C&P Homes Inc's chief financial officer John Huang told Reuters on Friday the firm expected nine months net profit to be close to two billion pesos against 1.421 billion a year-ago period.
"We expect it (nine months profit) to be close to two billion pesos," Huang said in an interview.
Asked about C&P Homes 1996 full year profit expectations, Huang said: "We think we will earn 2.7 billion pesos on revenues of nine billion pesos. We are on track to meeting this target."
In 1995, the company reported full year net profit of 2.011 billion pesos.
